tasks.title: Refresh newly created task worktrees from current protocol
tasks.objective: Apply the current protocol and active-feature snapshot to stale dependency checkpoints, enforce freshness for all new worktrees, and roll back newly created resources on failure.
tasks.test_seam: Use temporary git repositories with stale and current dependency checkpoints. Prove stale protocol refresh preserves dependency output and ancestry, freshness failure removes the just-created worktree and branch, and post-refresh task changes are still bounded by allowed_paths.

tasks.title: Adversarially evaluate worktree refresh and cleanup
tasks.objective: Try to falsify new-worktree freshness, scoped protocol refresh, dependency preservation, cleanup ownership, and completion allowed-path behavior.
tasks.test_seam: Review temporary-repository tests and implementation for failures during dependency merge, snapshot refresh, freshness assertion, and cleanup; verify unrelated branches/worktrees and dependency code are preserved.
